name: Android Hardware Back Button & Matchmaking Cancel
greenMarker: Android Back Button and Radar Cancel behavior verified
note: Back has to land where the on-screen Cancel button lands. Anything else drops the player out of the app mid-search, which reads as a crash.

mutations.name: the back button stops closing the matchmaking radar
mutations.why: Back then falls through to the system and closes the app while the player is queued. They come back to find the search gone and no explanation.

mutations.name: the first Back on Home closes the app (the original bug)
mutations.why: One press of back on the home screen quits the game with no warning; "press again to exit" is never shown.

mutations.name: Back leaves the battle result without clearing it (the original bug)
mutations.why: After one back from a battle result, every later back lands in the lobby again: the player cannot leave it with back, nor close a dialog over it.
mutations.expectFailure: not stuck on the battle screen

mutations.name: Back ignores the windows a screen opened itself (D43)
mutations.why: The release-32 bug: on Home, back said press again to exit with the rules card up, and a second press closed the app.
mutations.expectFailure: Back closes the Home rules card

mutations.name: a closed window stays on the list (D43)
mutations.why: Without the cleanup every later back on Home goes to a window that is gone, and the app can no longer be left with back.

mutations.name: the rules card is not on the list (D43)
mutations.why: One registration covers seven places: the info button on four screens and the first killer on three.
mutations.expectFailure: Back closes the Home rules card

mutations.name: the locked Ghost note is not on the list (D43)
mutations.why: The note stays until dismissed (gate 2-6), so back on Home met it often.
mutations.expectFailure: Back closes the locked Ghost note

mutations.name: the privacy page is not on the list (D43)
mutations.why: Back then left Settings with the page still drawn over Home.

mutations.name: the confirm dialog is not on the list (D43)
mutations.why: The dialog lives outside App: back asked the same question again in a game, and in Settings changed the screen under it.

mutations.name: Back on a finished game asks to leave it (D43, Gemini G1-1)
mutations.why: The old way: a leave question over a game already over, and Home without what its Home button tidies.
mutations.expectFailure: does not ask to leave a game already over
